target_customer: App developers, product managers and designers who want to collect user feedback inside their apps
problem: Developers needed an easy way to gather feedback from users inside the product. Audobox described itself as a developer and user friendly tool for in-app feedback.
business_model: Unknown; likely B2B SaaS for developers, but no source states pricing

founders.name: Ted Lee
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as a former YC founder (S13) and says he is now in engineering at Patreon (later employment).

founders.name: George Tankersley
founders.background_notes: YC page says previously Matasano, CoreOS, Cloudflare and Zcash; it does not say which came before 2013, so none is recorded as a prior employer.

founders.name: Will Whitney
founders.background_notes: YC page says later MIT MEng, NYU PhD and DeepMind; these came after the batch.

competitors.name: Apptentive
competitors.what: SDK for iOS and Android developers to run in-app surveys and conversations with users
competitors.funding_then: 1.2 million dollar seed from Founders Co-Op, Google Ventures, Social Leverage and Golden Venture Partners

technical_complexity.rationale: An embeddable feedback widget and SDK is standard engineering for a small team, though three technically strong founders are listed.

defensibility.rationale: Feedback widgets were easy to copy and no data or integration moat is evidenced.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent acting on Audobox. Apptentive, a rival in mobile feedback, raised a 1.2 million dollar seed round before this batch per TechCrunch.

market_need_then: Mobile app developers wanted feedback and ratings management inside apps; Apptentive and UserVoice existed. No independent demand data for Audobox was found.

branding.domain_note: audobox.com now hosts an unrelated AI audio toolbox site, so it is not the original company's site.

brand_strength.rationale: The name is a near copy of AudioBox, a separate music cloud player company, and no press on the feedback product was found.

outcome_analysis: Audobox was a Summer 2013 YC company building an in-app feedback tool. No funding, launch coverage, shutdown notice or post mortem was found, and searches mostly returned AudioBox.fm, a different music locker company, and Audm. The cause of inactivity is not public. The brand_confusion failure factor is only an inference from the name collisions that hid the company in search results.
notes: Dealroom lists an Audobox with two seed entries (125K and 120K) but its description is of a script learning materials site, so the entity does not match and no round is recorded. Competitor search found mostly current vendor pages; the only dated rival is Apptentive (TechCrunch, December 2012), so the list is short. AudioBox.fm (iCoreTech) is a different company. The current audobox.com is an AI audio tools site and unrelated.
